mapper.insert: insert into sale_order (order_no, customer_id, operator_id, dept_id, total_amount, actual_amount, pay_method, status, sale_time, remark, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{operatorId}, #{deptId}, #{totalAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{payMethod}, #{status}, #{saleTime}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
